# Adnxs / Xandr
> Enterprise advertising technology platform for programmatic buying, selling, curation, identity, and monetization.

Adnxs.com and its documentation properties provide technical resources for Xandr's advertising platform, including bidder and seller APIs, curation, reporting, identity, and integration guides for buyers, sellers, and developers.

## Platform Documentation
- [Xandr Documentation Home](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/): Central entry point for Xandr platform product and developer documentation.
- [Release Notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/release-notes/): Product and API release updates across Xandr platform capabilities.
- [Glossary](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/glossary/): Definitions for platform, advertising, and marketplace terminology used in documentation.
- [Getting Started](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/getting-started/): Introductory guidance for onboarding to Xandr products and workflows.

## Buyer Platform
- [Buyer Platform Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/): Overview of buyer-side platform APIs and related resources.
- [Campaign Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/campaign-service): Manage campaign objects and settings for buyer workflows.
- [Line Item Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/line-item-service): Create and manage line items, targeting, pacing, and delivery controls.
- [Creative Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/creative-service): Upload, manage, and audit creatives used in campaigns.
- [Profile Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/profile-service): Configure targeting profiles and audience-related settings.
- [Reporting Guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/reporting-guide): Learn reporting concepts, report types, and execution patterns.
- [Report Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/report-service): Run and retrieve reports programmatically from the platform.

## Seller Platform
- [Seller Platform Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/seller-tag/): Documentation for seller-side monetization and inventory management capabilities.
- [Placement Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/placement-service): Manage placements and inventory objects for monetized supply.
- [Publisher Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/publisher-service): Create and manage publisher entities and associated settings.
- [Ad Quality Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/ad-quality-service): Review and control ad quality settings and enforcement options.
- [Inventory Attribute Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/inventory-attribute-service): Work with inventory attributes used in classification and targeting.
- [Yield Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/monetize/): Seller-focused monetization documentation and operational guidance.

## Curate and Supply Path
- [Curate Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/curate/): Documentation for curation workflows, deal packaging, and supply path optimization.
- [Curated Deals](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/curate/curated-deals): Manage curated deal creation and distribution workflows.
- [Deal Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/deal-service): Create and manage private marketplace and deal objects.
- [Supply Path Optimization](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/curate/supply-path-optimization): Guidance for optimizing curated supply paths and access.
- [Marketplace Concepts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/marketplace/): Concepts and workflows for marketplace transactions and deal execution.

## Real-Time and Bidding APIs
- [Bidders Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/bidders/): Technical documentation for bidder integrations and bid request handling.
- [OpenRTB Specification Support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/bidders/openrtb-specification): Xandr-specific implementation details for OpenRTB bidding.
- [Bid Request Format](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/bidders/bid-request-format): Field-level guidance for interpreting incoming bid requests.
- [Bid Response Format](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/bidders/bid-response-format): Requirements and structure for valid bid responses.
- [Mobile Bid Requests](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/bidders/mobile-bid-requests): Mobile-specific bid request handling and field behavior.
- [Server-Side Cookie Sync](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/bidders/cookie-sync): Identity synchronization guidance for bidder integrations.

## Identity, Audiences, and Data
- [Identity Solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/identity/): Documentation for identity products, addressability, and user matching.
- [Segment Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/segment-service): Create and manage audience segments and related metadata.
- [Pixel Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/pixel-service): Manage conversion and audience pixels for tracking and attribution.
- [Batch Segment Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/batch-segment-service): Bulk operations for audience segment membership management.
- [User Sync](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/identity/user-sync): Guidance for syncing user identifiers with Xandr systems.
- [Data Management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/data-management/): Concepts and workflows for audience and data onboarding.

## Reporting and Analytics
- [Reporting Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/reporting/): Overview of reporting capabilities, dimensions, metrics, and workflows.
- [Standard Reports](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/reporting/standard-reports): Available standard report types and common use cases.
- [Dimensions and Metrics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/reporting/dimensions-and-metrics): Reference for report fields, dimensions, and measurement definitions.
- [Log-Level Data](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/log-level-data/): Documentation for log-level exports and event data access.
- [Report Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/report-service): API endpoint for submitting and retrieving reports.
- [Analytics Best Practices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/reporting/best-practices): Practical guidance for efficient report generation and interpretation.

## API Reference
- [Digital Platform API Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/): Main API reference for object services and operational endpoints.
- [Authentication Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/authentication-service): Authenticate API clients and manage session tokens.
- [Member Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/member-service): Access and manage member-level account configuration.
- [Advertiser Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/advertiser-service): Create and manage advertiser entities and settings.
- [Insertion Order Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/insertion-order-service): Manage insertion orders and budget structures for campaigns.
- [Payment Rule Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/payment-rule-service): Configure payment and revenue rules for transactions.
- [Object Model](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/object-model): Understand relationships among core platform entities.

## Integration Guides
- [API Best Practices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/api-best-practices): Recommendations for reliable, efficient, and scalable API integrations.
- [Pagination](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/pagination): Learn how to page through large API result sets.
- [Filtering and Sorting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/filtering-and-sorting): Query API resources using filters and sort parameters.
- [Error Codes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/error-codes): Reference for common API errors and troubleshooting guidance.
- [Rate Limits](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/rate-limits): Understand API throttling behavior and integration considerations.
- [Webhook and Notification Concepts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/xandr/digital-platform-api/notifications): Guidance for event-driven integration patterns where supported.
